title: Synthesized Voices Were Reportedly Used by Torswats to Sell Swatting Calls Targeting Schools and Homes

behaviors.text: A Telegram user or channel known as Torswats reportedly offered paid swatting services and uploaded recordings of false emergency calls using synthesized or computer-generated voices.
Reported targets included high schools, private residences, streamers, businesses, and police departments; some calls prompted lockdowns, searches, or armed law-enforcement responses.
The exact voice-generation tool was not identified.
